description:
Every runtime, interpreter and source.rs decoder (34 sites today) goes through Bin::of_binary(word) / of_stored. Native keeps emit_binary_bit_len and emit_binary_base, and receive's length read uses emit_binary_bit_len instead of fz_bs_bit_len_ref.

Deletes: bitstring_like_word, the word-form bitstring_byte_ptr, the 6 duplicate is_bitstring_like tests, and byte_aligned_binary_slice.

Acceptance:
- grep shows 0 decoders outside Bin and the two emitters.
- Bench A/B with the == group judged against the page's 8-instruction listing (recovers #827's +2).

Page: https://claude.ai/artifact/7oEdkmwEoL8RVcfbYXPZzg (From: Binary Handling), approved by the user 2026-11-23 (relayed by Binary Handling). Owner: Binary Handling.
title: One decoder: Bin::of_binary
